_comment: Dated exceptions for scripts/auditGate.mjs. Add an entry ONLY when no patched release exists, and give it an expires date no more than 45 days away (the gate rejects later dates). An expired entry fails the gate again.

entries.reason: picomatch <=4.0.7 ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. 4.0.7 is the latest release (checked 2026-11-17), so there is nothing to upgrade to. Dev/build tooling only: vite, tailwindcss, firebase-tools and vitest at the root; vitest and jest (firebase-functions-test) in functions/. `npm ls picomatch --omit=dev` is empty in both trees, so it is in neither the deployed functions nor the site bundle.
